subject: *: use model.CIStr in infoschema v2 to handle case insensitive (#55450)
summary: Diff converts infoschema v2 name-bearing items (db/table) from lowercased strings to `model.CIStr`, and consistently compares/sorts by `.L` while preserving `.O` for display. Meta fast-path name extraction switches from matching `"L"` to matching `"O"` so schema-cache name→ID mappings retain original case, aligning infoschema v2 outputs (e.g., INFORMATION_SCHEMA views) with case-preserving behavior without changing lookup semantics.
